name: News desk
description: One take on one story, tightened into a short news video: a hook in the first line, the facts in order, sources on screen, and a red lower third.
author: CucCut

examples.title: Lower third
examples.note: The source sits in a red bar at the bottom left, in capitals, for the whole quote; nothing else shares the bar.

quickActions.label: Tighten the take
quickActions.text: Tighten {selection}: cut the stalls, retakes and filler words, and keep every fact and its source.

quickActions.label: Add sources
quickActions.text: Put the source of each fact in {selection} on screen as a red lower third while that fact is said.

quickActions.label: Headline options
quickActions.text: Write five headline options for {selection} in the news desk style, then use the one I pick as the opening title.
